title: Your Fault: London
plot_overview: A young couple begins separate new chapters, with one entering the business world and the other starting university. As new people, temptations, rivalries, and betrayals complicate their lives, their relationship faces mounting pressure and they must decide how hard to fight for it.
will_you_like_this: You’ll enjoy this if you like emotionally charged young-adult romance, relationship obstacles, and stories about love under pressure; Not for you if you prefer quieter, less melodramatic dramas.
review_summary: Pros: romantic tension; emotional stakes; fresh-start setting | Cons: familiar conflicts; relationship drama; heightened melodrama
